server.note: Vite announced http://localhost:5173/, the same as the resolved base_url. Started from D:/personal/Photo/composition with npm run dev -- --port 5173 --strictPort. Stopped with TaskStop and doctor.mjs stop (stopped: true, free_after: true). Desktop checks AC-6.5 to AC-6.13 and three desktop sweep surfaces were driven in the Playwright MCP Chromium browser at 1280x800; photos were added through the real Додати фото file chooser (browser_file_upload) and spreads were seeded through window.__store with applyTemplate/placePhoto, as tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts does. AC-6.14 and the mobile sweep were driven in real WebKit 27.2 with the iPhone 13 device profile (390x664), by a Node script in the scratchpad that uses the project's @playwright/test 1.64.1 against the same server. Two script-side aborts were re-run from a fresh navigation and are not product findings: the first AC-6.5 run stopped at the MCP file-chooser modal before any assertion, and the first AC-6.10 run waited on spread-position, which the desktop editor does not render. The MCP network list is cumulative over the session, so each desktop .net.log holds earlier traffic too; every response in every log is 200 or 304.

checks.deviation: Playwright 1.64.1 WebKit can tap but cannot send a native touch move, so no real finger swipe was possible. Two equivalent facets were driven in real WebKit 27.2 with the iPhone 13 profile instead: a right-to-left pointer drag through page.mouse, and a right-to-left PointerEvent sequence with pointerType touch dispatched on the preview.

assertions.then: spread 2 shows
assertions.actual: preview opened at spread 1 (1 / 15); right-to-left page.mouse drag -> data-spread-index 2, img land-2.jpg

assertions.then: the swipe does not scroll the page (falsifier)
assertions.actual: preview computed touch-action none; window scroll [0,0,0] before and after the drag

assertions.then: a pointerType touch swipe changes the spread (substitute facet)
assertions.actual: right-to-left touch-type swipe 2 -> 3, left-to-right 3 -> 2; a 30 px move (under the 50 px threshold) left the spread at 2

deviations.what: The swipe was driven as a page.mouse pointer drag and as a dispatched PointerEvent sequence with pointerType touch, in real WebKit with the iPhone 13 profile, not as a native touch gesture.
deviations.why: Playwright 1.64.1 Touchscreen has only tap(); WebKit has no CDP to send touch moves. The preview handles pointer events only and sets touch-action none, so both facets reach the same handler that a finger swipe reaches.
